lines.text: Nahum the Elkoshite receives a vision against Nineveh and says the LORD is slow to anger and great in power.
The LORD dries up the sea and rivers, the mountains quake before Him, and Bashan and Carmel wither.
The LORD is a stronghold in the day of distress, and with an overwhelming fire He will make an end of Nineveh.
The LORD says He will afflict Judah no longer and will break the yoke from its neck and tear away its shackles.
The LORD will cut off the carved image from the house of Nineveh's gods and prepare its throne.
